description.value:
Scaling walls, cliffs, and trees comes naturally to you. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, and advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid falling while climbing. You may also spend 5 minutes coaching up to six willing creatures (yourself included) within 30 feet before a climb; each coached creature adds 1d6 to any ability check or saving throw it makes during that climb.
